verdict.rationale: The skill ships dependency-free Python tools and a reference library searchable from the command line, so parts of it can be scripted without a UI. The core design workflow is an interactive agent session with a human checkpoint where nothing else is produced until the user picks a direction, and nothing documents headless or CI use. Missing for 10: documented headless/non-interactive mode, CI integration examples, a way to bypass the human selection checkpoint, and independent corroboration of automated runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
